description: ela — SessionStart: context injection, no writes. SessionEnd: report an uncommitted or unpushed elak, never commit it — knowledge is committed by hand after Evan's confirm. PreToolUse: the write guard — place (nothing under the published directory, nothing in ela/helm from a session started elsewhere, nothing under a remote site's elak, nothing under <elak> outside blueprint/knowledge/map) and content (no tracked file and no commit message may quote what someone said, name a person, or narrate what a session got wrong).
